name: claude-in-claude
description: Home of the claude plugin: run headless Claude Code workers as managed subagents from Claude Code.

plugins.name: headless-workers
plugins.description: Run headless Claude Code workers as managed subagents — a handle at once, a compact log, one call that waits for the result and wakes you on stalls, steering with send, stop and resume, groups with a worktree per writer, and schema-shaped results, each turn pinned to a permission profile.
